content.text: Coming up, we have one of my favorite phrases in the English language. I don't know why I like it so much, but it is a great name for a piece of furniture.

content.text: Fine. Just get it. We have been shopping for furniture for five hours. I'm so tired.
content.trans: 好的。直接去拿吧。我们已经花五个小时在家具上选了。我好累。

content.text: We still need to find an arm-war and a dresser.
content.trans: 我们还需要找一个战士和一个裁缝。

content.text: Fine. I'm going to go home and drop off this nice stand, coffee table and love seat while you look for the rest of the things.
content.trans: 好的。我打算去家里把这个漂亮的展台、咖啡桌和沙发放好，你接着找其他的吧。

content.text: Great. Pick me up in about an hour because I think I'll also get a bean bag and a dining set.
content.trans: 好的。大约一个小时后接我，因为我打算也买个沙发和一套餐桌椅。

content.text: While you're at it, can you pick up a nicer cleaner? I really want one so I can watch TV.
content.trans: 在你玩的时候，你能找一个更干净的清洁工吗？我真的想有一个，所以我可以看电视。

content.text: Recliner? In my beautifully decorated living room? I don't think so.
content.trans: 沙发？在我的漂亮装饰过的客厅里吗？我觉得不太可能。

content.text: Alright, we're back. So talking about furniture, it's very interesting. How do you take it home?
content.trans: 好的，我们又见面了。说到家具，真是太有趣了。你是怎么带回家的？

content.text: What do you do? And in this case, they were transporting it themselves.
content.trans: 你做什么？在这情况下，他们自己运输的。

content.text: And the guy said, I'm going to go home and drop off this nightstand, coffee table and love seat.
content.trans: 他说道，我打算回家把床、咖啡桌和沙发都放下。

content.text: So to drop off.
content.trans: 所以去送。

content.text: Okay, this is a great verb. To drop off. It's a verbal phrase.
content.trans: 好的，这是一个很好的动词。丢下车。这是一个短语。

content.text: So the preposition there is off, not on.
content.trans: 所以那个介词是错的，不是在。

content.text: Right. So I could say, for example, Marco, I'm just going to drop off my bag at home and then I'll meet you guys for dinner.
content.trans: 好的。比如我可以这样说，Marco，我打算把我的包留在家里，然后晚上我会和你们一起吃饭。

content.text: That means I'm going to go to my house and put down my bag and then I'll leave.
content.trans: 那我就去我家里，把包放下，然后就走。

content.text: So to drop off is basically to go somewhere so you can put something in that place.
content.trans: 所以丢东西就是基本上是去某个地方，然后你可以把东西放在那里。

content.text: But it doesn't mean that you're going to go to that place and stay there.
content.trans: 但那并不意味着你真的要去那个地方并呆在那里。

content.text: So if I say I'm going to drop off the kids at school, that means I'm going to take the kids and leave them at school and then go away.
content.trans: 所以，如果我说我要把孩子们送到学校，那意味着我将带着孩子们离开学校，并且自己也离开了。

content.text: It doesn't mean you're going to school yourself.
content.trans: 这并不意味着你要自己上学。

content.text: Right, exactly.
content.trans: 好的，没错。

content.text: So can you drop off the laundry at the dry cleaners, please?
content.trans: 当然，你可以把洗衣送到干洗店吗？

content.text: Very good. So I'm going to take the laundry to the dry cleaners, leave it there and then go somewhere else.
content.trans: 很好。所以我打算把洗衣送到干洗店，放在那儿，然后去别的地方。

content.text: So what happens at three o'clock when the kids are still at school?
content.trans: 那么，当孩子们还在学校的时候，三点钟发生了什么？

content.text: That's right. Now we use the opposite verbal phrase and that is to pick up.
content.trans: 正确。现在我们使用反义词短语，就是去接。

content.text: Okay, drop off, pick up.
content.trans: 好的，交上去，拿回来。

content.text: So you go pick up the kids, you go pick up the laundry.
content.trans: 所以你去接孩子，你去洗衣服。

content.text: So this isn't just about picking something up from a table or the ground.
content.trans: 所以这不仅仅是捡到从桌子上或地上拿来的。

content.text: You can actually use your car to pick something up.
content.trans: 你可以用你的车去取东西。

content.text: Right, you go and retrieve it.
content.trans: 好的，你去拿一下。

content.text: So I'm going to the post office to pick up my package.
content.trans: 我打算去邮局取我的包裹。

content.text: Very good. So phrases that you're going to have to use if you're talking about furniture,
content.trans: 很好。所以如果你要谈论家具的话，你可能需要使用这些术语。

content.text: if you're talking about buying something.
content.trans: 如果你在讨论买什么东西。

content.text: And while we're on the topic, I know that one of the most popular places to buy furniture is IKEA.
content.trans: 当然，你知道家具市场上最受欢迎的地方之一是宜家吗？

content.text: Are you a big fan of IKEA?
content.trans: 你是不是IKEA的大粉丝？

content.text: I like IKEA and I love what they've done for people who don't want to spend too much money on furniture.
content.trans: 我喜欢 IKEA，他们为那些不想花太多钱买家具的人做了很多。

content.text: Furniture is expensive.
content.trans: 家具很贵。

content.text: Furniture is very expensive. You can spend $5,000 on a sofa.
content.trans: 家具非常昂贵。你可以花五千块钱买一把沙发。

content.text: And so IKEA is a wonderful brand and I think a wonderful company because it makes good looking furniture affordable.
content.trans: 所以，IKEA是一个很棒的品牌和公司，我认为它能够让价格实惠的好家具变得美好。

content.text: And it's because you put it together yourself, right?
content.trans: 是的，是因为你自己组装的吧？

content.text: That's right, a lot of things you have to assemble or put together by yourself.
content.trans: 没错，你得自己拼装或组装很多东西。

content.text: So you buy it in a box and then you make it.
content.trans: 所以你买它在一个盒子里，然后你就做了。

content.text: And it's a little bit frustrating sometimes.
content.trans: 确实有时候会有点儿让人觉得不太舒服。

content.text: But for people like me and I'm sure people like you, it's part of the fun is putting stuff together.
content.trans: 但对我来说，和你一样的人，把东西组合起来的一部分乐趣就是。

content.text: Yeah, because you kind of feel like you kind of built it but you really didn't.
content.trans: 是的，因为你感觉自己其实自己搭建了，但实际上并没有。

content.text: So it kind of gives you that false sense of accomplishment.
content.trans: 所以它让你有一种虚假的成就感。

content.text: It's like I'm in the 19th century and I can make my own furniture.
content.trans: 感觉像是我生活在19世纪，可以自己动手做家具。

content.text: So it's very popular.
content.trans: 确实很受欢迎。

content.text: I've actually, apart from having great furniture, I understand that they have amazing meatballs.
content.trans: 我除了家具很好，我也知道他们肉丸子很棒。

content.text: They do.
content.trans: 他们这样做。

content.text: Well, I'm Swedish. I never get to eat Swedish meatballs and here in China they do have some of the better meatballs around.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我叫瑞典人。我在中国吃一些更好的肉丸。

content.text: So I would recommend if you haven't tried them. Try them. They're pretty good.
content.trans: 我建议你如果还没试过的话，就试试看吧。它们挺不错的。

content.text: Yeah, good idea.
content.trans: 好主意。

content.text: Good idea. Have some dinner.
content.trans: 好主意。吃点晚饭吧。

content.text: Let me know. Our website is englispa.com. Do you like IKEA and do you love their meatballs?
content.trans: 请告诉我。我们的网站是englispa.com。你喜欢IKEA吗，你爱他们的肉丸吗？

content.text: All right, we'll see you guys there. Bye.
content.trans: 好的，我们到时候见。拜拜。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 再见。
